title: 2020 YABANCI DİL BİLGİSİ SEVİYE TESPİT SINAVI (2020-YDS/1) İNGİLİZCE

questions.questionText: 1. Twenty-five hundred years ago, ancient Greek philosophers turned their highly sophisticated ---- away from the whims of the gods and toward questions of the natural world.
questions.explanation: Antik Yunan filozoflarının tanrıların heveslerinden uzaklaşıp doğal dünya sorularına yönelttikleri şey oldukça sofistike 'sorgulamaları / araştırmaları' (inquiries) olmalıdır. Diğer seçenekler (yanılgılar, teşvikler, şikayetler, önlemler) bağlama uymaz.
options: A) inquiries
B) fallacies
C) incentives
D) complaints
E) precautions

questions.questionText: 2. The mission control experts cannot tell if the space junk is going to hit the space station or not, but they are sure that a ---- would knock a hole in the body and cause all air inside it to quickly escape into space.
questions.explanation: Uzay çöpünün (space junk) uzay istasyonuna çarpıp çarpmayacağı tartışılıyor. Çarpması durumunda oluşacak 'çarpışma' (collision) gövdede bir delik açacaktır.
options: A) succession
B) collision
C) conversion
D) fluctuation
E) deviation

questions.questionText: 3. While newspapers have been in dramatic decline in much of the developed West, the industry is still growing in many of Asia's booming and ---- cities.
questions.explanation: Cümlede zıtlık bağlacı (While) kullanılmıştır. Batı'da gazeteler düşüşteyken, Asya'nın gelişen (booming) ve 'kârlı / kazançlı' (profitable) şehirlerinde büyümeye devam etmektedir.
options: A) fragile
B) profitable
C) confidential
D) peculiar
E) notorious

questions.questionText: 4. As the DNA of two unrelated people only differs by about one in every 1,000 base pairs, humans show ---- little genetic diversity.
questions.explanation: İki akraba olmayan insanın DNA'sı sadece 1000'de 1 oranında farklılık gösterdiğinden, insanlar 'dikkat çekici / şaşırtıcı derecede' (remarkably) az genetik çeşitlilik gösterirler.
options: A) remarkably
B) elaborately
C) ambiguously
D) sufficiently
E) promptly

questions.questionText: 5. Biologists have created a molecule that ---- the connections between cells, called neurons, acting exactly like the steel bars in reinforced concrete.
questions.explanation: Molekülün nöronlar arasındaki bağlantılara ne yaptığı, betonarmedeki çelik çubukların (steel bars) işlevine benzetilmiştir. Çelik çubuklar betonu 'güçlendirir/sağlamlaştırır' (fortifies).
options: A) penetrates
B) overcomes
C) implements
D) fortifies
E) receives

questions.questionText: 6. Internet users are increasingly ---- cyberchondria, a mental condition in which easy access to information on medical issues causes increased feelings of anxiety over health.
questions.explanation: İnternet kullanıcılarının 'siberkondri' adı verilen zihinsel bir duruma giderek daha fazla 'yakalandığı/tutulduğu' (coming down with) ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) making up for
B) cutting down on
C) getting away with
D) looking around for
E) coming down with

questions.questionText: 7. So far, only two types of mental exertion ---- to improve overall cognitive ability: one is musical training, the other is learning a new language or practising a second one you ----.
questions.explanation: 'So far' (şu ana kadar) ifadesi Present Perfect Tense (have been shown) gerektirir. İkinci kısımda ise önceden/zaten öğrenmiş olduğunuz (have already learned) bir dilden bahsedilir.
options: A) were shown / will have already learned
B) had been shown / have already been learning
C) have been shown / have already learned
D) will be shown / already learned
E) are shown / had already learned

questions.questionText: 8. If an age could ever be rightly described as 'dark' in European history, it ---- the two centuries that ---- the collapse of Roman authority in Britain at the beginning of the fifth century.
questions.explanation: If cümlesi Type 2 (hayali/varsayımsal durum) yapısındadır (could be -> would be). İkinci boşluk ise 5. yüzyılın başlarındaki Roma otoritesinin çöküşünü 'takip eden' (followed) geçmişteki iki yüzyılı tanımlar.
options: A) may be / follow
B) would be / followed
C) used to be / had followed
D) must be / have followed
E) had to be / were following

questions.questionText: 9. Wall paintings previously ---- in three Spanish caves have now been dated to 65,000 years ago - some 20,000 years before Homo sapiens is thought ---- in Europe.
questions.explanation: Daha önce 'keşfedilen' (discovered - kısaltma) duvar resimleri ve Homo sapiens'in Avrupa'ya 'varmış olduğu düşünülen' (is thought to have arrived - geçmişe dönük perfect infinitive) ifadeleri doğru yapıdır.
options: A) to have been discovered / to arrive
B) being discovered / having arrived
C) discovered / to have arrived
D) having been discovered / to be arriving
E) to be discovered / arriving

questions.questionText: 10. A compound called yloins that can be found in the frog's lymph and skin glands increases the frog's brightness ---- around 20 percent ---- a full moon.
questions.explanation: Bir miktar/oran belirten artış veya azalışlarda 'by' kullanılır (yüzde 20 oranında). Dolunay 'sırasında/esnasında' (during) parlaklığı artırır.
options: A) by / during
B) in / under
C) at / over
D) to / along
E) from / through

questions.questionText: 11. The scientific study of the dynamic relationship ---- the celestial bodies of the solar system and the motion of human-made objects ---- outer space, such as spacecraft and satellites, is called orbital mechanics.
questions.explanation: Güneş sistemindeki gök cisimleri 'arasındaki' (among - ikiden fazla) dinamik ilişki ve insan yapımı nesnelerin dış uzay'daki' (in) hareketini inceler.
options: A) about / on
B) between / at
C) with / of
D) among / in
E) beyond / without

questions.questionText: 12. ---- electricity and heat account for 41 percent of global carbon dioxide emissions today, curbing climate change will require satisfying that much demand with renewables rather than fossil fuels.
questions.explanation: Elektrik ve ısı, emisyonların yüzde 41'ini oluşturduğu 'için/nedeniyle' (Since), iklim değişikliğini engellemek yenilenebilir enerjiyi gerektirecektir (Sebep-Sonuç ilişkisi).
options: A) Since
B) While
C) Until
D) Unless
E) As if

questions.questionText: 13. ---- all dogs show signs of having 'theory of mind', which enables them to grasp that we think differently from them, it is unlikely that they are capable of extending this to knowing the reason why one person behaves differently to another.
questions.explanation: Tüm köpekler zihin kuramına sahip olma belirtileri gösterse 'de / rağmen' (Even though), bu durumu bir kişinin diğerinden neden farklı davrandığını bilecek kadar genişletebilmeleri pek olası değildir (Zıtlık ilişkisi).
options: A) In case
B) Only if
C) As far as
D) Given that
E) Even though

questions.questionText: 14. ---- there are hundreds of school-and community-based aggression prevention and skills promotion programmes, only a few of these appear to be effective.
questions.explanation: Yüzlerce program 'olmasına rağmen' (Although), sadece birkaç tanesi etkili görünmektedir (Zıtlık ilişkisi).
options: A) Provided that
B) Since
C) Although
D) Just as
E) Unless

questions.questionText: 15. Finding ammonia on the surface of Pluto could be a hint of more complex organic chemistry on the planet, although it is ---- cold ---- there is almost definitely no life there.
questions.explanation: Gezegen 'o kadar' soğuktur 'ki' (so / that) orada neredeyse kesinlikle hayat yoktur.
options: A) not only / but also
B) both / and
C) neither / nor
D) such / that
E) so / that

questions.questionText: 16. ---- the Sun's constant stream of energy, water molecules are continually evaporating from the surfaces of oceans and lakes, adding to the water vapour in the air.
questions.explanation: Güneş'in sürekli enerji akışı 'sayesinde / yüzünden' (Thanks to) su molekülleri sürekli olarak buharlaşır.
options: A) Rather than
B) Thanks to
C) As opposed to
D) In terms of
E) Unlike

questions.questionText: 17. The first civilisations emerged in areas where high agricultural productivity was possible, supporting dense populations. In the Old World, they appeared (17)---- the rivers in Mesopotamia, northern India, Egypt and northern China.
questions.explanation: İlk medeniyetler Mezopotamya, Mısır vb. yerlerdeki nehirler 'boyunca' (along) ortaya çıktılar.
options: A) at
B) into
C) with
D) along
E) toward

questions.questionText: 18. Craft specialisation developed, trade flourished, writing began, and rulers were often given elaborate burials. (18)----, each civilisation also had unique features rooted in its own cultural background and environment.
questions.explanation: Bir önceki cümlede medeniyetlerin ortak/genel gelişimi sayılırken, burada 'bununla birlikte / ancak' (However) her medeniyetin kendine has özellikleri de vardı diyerek zıtlık kurulur.
options: A) Instead
B) However
C) For instance
D) Otherwise
E) That is

questions.questionText: 19. Life in Ancient Egypt evolved around the Nile, which provided a regular water supply and fertile soils and thus, (19)---- the surrounding desert regions, made agricultural production possible.
questions.explanation: Nil nehri, çevresindeki çöl bölgelerinin 'aksine' (by contrast with) tarımsal üretimi mümkün kıldı.
options: A) in terms of
B) thanks to
C) in place of
D) by contrast with
E) by means of

questions.questionText: 20. Navigation on the river was easy, as boats (20)---- northwards with the current.
questions.explanation: Nehirde ulaşım kolaydı, çünkü tekneler akıntıyla birlikte kuzeye doğru seyahat 'edebiliyorlardı' (could travel - geçmişteki yetenek).
options: A) could travel
B) ought to travel
C) may have travelled
D) must have travelled
E) would have travelled

questions.questionText: 21. This process of unification was (21)----- by trading contacts and the need to control the floodwaters of the Nile.
questions.explanation: Bu birleşme süreci ticari temaslar ve sel sularını kontrol etme ihtiyacı tarafından 'teşvik edildi / desteklendi' (encouraged).
options: A) abandoned
B) distributed
C) encouraged
D) overlooked
E) threatened

questions.questionText: 22. Pictures of dying seabirds show the (22)---- of such environmental damage. Yet, not all environmental hazards are this obvious.
questions.explanation: Ölmekte olan deniz kuşlarının resimleri, bu tür çevresel hasarın 'boyutunu/kapsamını' (extent) gösterir.
options: A) improvement
B) extent
C) suspension
D) eradication
E) release

questions.questionText: 23. Water pollution (23)---- by the uncontrolled use of pesticides and heavy metals, such as mercury, lead, cadmium, and zinc, largely remains unnoticed.
questions.explanation: Pestisitlerin kontrolsüz kullanımı tarafından 'tetiklenen' (triggered - passive reduction) su kirliliği büyük ölçüde fark edilmeden kalır.
options: A) having triggered
B) triggered
C) to have been triggered
D) triggering
E) to have triggered

questions.questionText: 24. The dangerous prior assumption that the oceans could naturally purify themselves (24)---- limit has caused possibly irreparable damage.
questions.explanation: Okyanusların kendilerini 'sınırsızca' veya 'sınır olmadan' (without limit) temizleyebileceği varsayımı telafisi mümkün olmayan hasarlara yol açtı.
options: A) from
B) upon
C) against
D) for
E) without

questions.questionText: 25. Many lakes have become polluted (25)---- the chemicals added by household wastewater and the overfertilisation with phosphates in agriculture.
questions.explanation: Birçok göl, evsel atıksular ve aşırı gübreleme tarafından eklenen kimyasallar 'yüzünden / sebebiyle' (because of) kirlenmiştir.
options: A) except for
B) because of
C) contrary to
D) rather than
E) in pursuit of

questions.questionText: 26. (26)----, unknown effluents from industry and acid rain add to the acidification of water bodies, which contributes to the decrease of biodiversity.
questions.explanation: Sayılan kirlilik sebeplerine ek olarak 'ayrıca/dahası' (Moreover) sanayi atıkları ve asit yağmuru da suların asitlenmesine katkıda bulunur.
options: A) For instance
B) Therefore
C) Even so
D) Moreover
E) Instead

questions.questionText: 27. Because there has been growing public awareness regarding cultural and ethnic differences around the world, ----.
questions.explanation: Tüm dünyada kültürel ve etnik farklılıklarla ilgili halk farkındalığı arttığı için, standart kavramlardan ziyade kültürel otantiklik (sahicilik) sunan turizm ürünlerine yönelik artan bir talep olmuştur.
options: A) tourists, who search for unfamiliar environments and cultures, also search for familiar facilities available for them
B) the true cultural heritage of the host society maintains its integrity by keeping tourists on the other side of the curtain
C) culture is seen as a dynamic living concept and changes continually in order to embrace the needs of present-day society
D) it has been argued that so-called authenticity of culture is a fleeting movement in the development calendar
E) there has been increasing demand for tourism products that offer cultural authenticity rather than standard concepts

questions.questionText: 28. Although all archaeologists agree that keeping careful records of an excavation is essential to good practice, ----.
questions.explanation: Tüm arkeologlar bir kazıda dikkatli kayıt tutmanın iyi bir uygulama için gerekli olduğu konusunda hemfikir 'olmalarına rağmen' (Although), arkeolojik veriyi tam olarak neyin oluşturduğu konusunda kesin bir fikir birliği yoktur.
options: A) there is a close relationship between their interpretation and that of archaeological museum
B) they are concerned with the activities of people and nature that create evidence of a cultural past
C) artefacts, sculptures and drawings in test caves help them learn about early humans
D) many mapping techniques developed for use on land have also been adapted for underwater archaeology
E) there is no certain consensus on what exactly constitutes archaeological data

questions.questionText: 29. As more people suffer from insecure attachment styles in their relationships with others, ----
questions.explanation: Giderek daha fazla insan başkalarıyla olan ilişkilerinde güvensiz bağlanma stillerinden muzdarip 'oldukça' (As), nesneler/eşyalar (possessions) sevdiklerinin yerini alarak onlara kendilerini güvende hissettirmez.
options: A) they feel that they do not need their belongings to survive anymore
B) seeing possessions as an extension of themselves starts to decrease
C) the needs for security are more complex than just the basics for physical survival
D) possessions do not make them feel secure by substituting for the loved ones
E) the behaviour of seeking emotional comfort from material objects is likely to rise

questions.questionText: 30. While mainstream cultural artefacts (films, books, fashion, etc.) produced specifically for and about girls have been popular for more than two centuries, ----.
questions.explanation: Kızlar için üretilen ana akım kültürel eserler iki yüzyıldan uzun süredir popüler 'olmasına rağmen' (While), kızlar ve onların kız kültürüyle karmaşık ilişkileri hakkındaki akademik araştırmalar iletişim disiplininde hala oldukça yenidir.
options: A) academic research on girls and their complex relations with girl culture is still fairly new to the communication discipline
B) early research on this topic tended to focus on girls as passive audiences and as vulnerable to the effects of mass culture
C) communication scholars examining girl culture today have been greatly influenced by girls' or girlhood studies
D) a new area that is mainly interested in how girls actively negotiate and even resist these cultural artefacts is needed
E) many researchers have examined the Internet as a space fostering girls' self-expression and community building

questions.questionText: 31. When bacteria sense that their numbers have reached a critical threshold, ----.
questions.explanation: Bakteriler sayılarının kritik bir eşiğe ulaştığını hissettiklerinde, insan konakçılarına (host) saldıran maddelerin üretimini başlatırlar (switch on the production).
options: A) the drugs that will interrupt this process are still being researched
B) they switch on the production of substances that attack their human host
C) we are not still sure about how to prevent them from increasing in number
D) some are mostly resistant to many common antibiotics, making an infection hard to treat
E) plant products have been reported to have no significant effect on their growth

questions.questionText: 32. It may be a long time before we are certain that biological life exists in outer space, ----.
questions.explanation: Dış uzayda biyolojik yaşamın var olduğundan emin olmamız uzun zaman alabilir, 'fakat Mars'ta yapılan son araştırmalar umutları artırdı' (but recent investigations of Mars have raised hopes) zıtlığı bağlamı tamamlar.
options: A) but recent investigations of Mars have raised hopes
B) as scientists...
C) while it takes a lot on the part of ordinary people to understand the dynamics of life in outer space
D) though professional associations informing people about microbial life in space have not been very successful
E) so the discovery of the bacteria in Earth that can live by extracting nutrition from the air, indicates that life can thrive without complex organic material

questions.questionText: 33. ----, few realise that moderate to vigorous physical activity done regularly completely changes our bodies from the inside out.
questions.explanation: Çoğu insan fiziksel olarak inaktif/hareketsiz olmanın zararlı olduğunu sezgisel olarak bilse de (While most people inherently know...), düzenli yapılan yoğun fiziksel aktivitenin bedenimizi içten dışa tamamen değiştirdiğini çok azı (few realise) fark eder.
options: A) Since regular movement prevents certain cancers and lowers the risk of diabetes
B) As scientists have developed methods for measuring intensity of aerobic exercise
C) While most people inherently know that they are aware that being physically sedentary habits
D) Since the increase in oil prices has appeared in many developing nations in the last several decades
E) If worldwide drought, which affects wide territories, is seen as the consequence of climate change

questions.questionText: 34. ---- food shortages will be inevitable, leading to mass starvation and unrest.
questions.explanation: Tarımsal üretim artan dünya nüfusuna ve gıda talebine yanıt verecek şekilde artırılmadıkça / bir çözüm bulunmadıkça (Unless a solution...), gıda kıtlıkları kaçınılmaz olacaktır.
options: A) Because many governments are committed to avoiding a reduction in farming subsidies and financial speculation nowadays
B) Unless a solution to the dramatic increase in world population and the demand for food is found
C) While the growing population in some parts of the world increasingly demand a more varied diet
D) Since the increase in oil prices has appeared in many developing nations in the last several decades
E) If worldwide drought, which affects wide territories, is seen as the consequence of climate change

questions.questionText: 35. The consequences of eating disorders need to be taken seriously, ----.
questions.explanation: Yeme bozukluklarının sonuçları ciddiye alınmalıdır, 'çünkü / göz önüne alındığında' (given that) bunlar yüksek tansiyon ve diyabet gibi durumların gelişme riskini artırabilir.
options: A) whereas there is growing interest in and worry about their potential risks and treatment methods
B) while evidence is now emerging that they occur in a wide range of socioeconomic groups
C) given that they might increase one's risk of developing conditions such as high blood pressure and diabetes
D) though clinical depression and anxiety disorders have been reported to commonly co-occur with eating disorders
E) so patients who engage in binge eating, which is highly associated with obesity, suffer from numerous health issues

questions.questionText: 36. Most classic research indicates that it is extremely difficult to identify boys from girls on behavioural grounds when children are under two years of age ----.
questions.explanation: Çoğu klasik araştırma, çocukların iki yaşın altında olduğu durumlarda davranışsal temelde erkekleri kızlardan ayırt etmenin son derece zor olduğunu gösterir, 'giyim gibi bazı dışsal kültürel cinsiyet göstergeleri olmadıkça' (unless there are some external cultural indicators).
options: A) unless there are some external cultural indicators of gender such as clothing,
B) so that the impact of gender in young children's lives could be examined in great detail
C) if young children know about gender and acquire gendered ways of being and thinking from an early age
D) given that preschool children often actively negotiate gender in their own behaviours and that of their peers
E) because there has recently been research on how boys and girls play with the toys

questions.questionText: 37. Because volcanic activity has usually been extremely violent and destructive, in the past there were some cultures believing that eruptions and tremblings had to be the fault of humans.
questions.explanation: Because = için, dolayı. 'Volkanik faaliyetler genellikle aşırı derecede şiddetli ve yıkıcı oldukları için, geçmişte patlamaların ve sarsılmaların insanların hatasından kaynaklandığını düşünen/inanan bazı kültürler vardı' anlamını en iyi A şıkkı verir.
options: A) Volkanik faaliyetler genellikle aşırı derecede şiddetli ve yıkıcı oldukları için geçmişte patlamaların ve sarsılmaların insanların hatasından kaynaklandığını düşünen bazı kültürler vardı.
B) Volkanik faaliyetlerin genellikle aşırı derecede şiddetli ve yıkıcı olmasından dolayı geçmişte bazı kültürler patlamaların ve sarsılmaların insanların hata kaynaklandığına inanıyordu.
C) Genellikle aşırı derecede siddetli ve yıkıcı olan volkanik faaliyetler yüzünden geçmişte yaşanan patlamaların ve sarsılmaların insanların hatasından kaynaklandığına inanan bazı kültürler vardı.
D) Geçmişte patlamaların ve sarsılmaların insanların hatasından kaynaklandığına inanan kültürler olmasının sebebi, bazı volkanik faaliyetlerin genellikle son derece şiddetli ve yıkıcı olmasıydı.

E) Geçmişte patlamaların ve sarsılmaların insanların hatasından kaynaklandığına inanan bazı kültürlerin olmas volkanik faaliyetlerin genellikle son derece siddetli ve yıkıcı olmasından kaynaklanıyordu.

questions.questionText: 38. According to a recent report, early adopters of enterprise artificial intelligence have shown a bigger improvement in productivity and performance compared to those that have yet to explore this exciting new field.
questions.explanation: According to = göre. 'Yeni bir rapora göre, yapay zekâ girişimini önceden benimseyenler, bu heyecan verici yeni alanı henüz keşfetmemiş olanlara kıyasla verimlilik ve performans bakımından daha büyük bir gelişme göstermiştir.' Cümle yapısını en iyi yansıtan A seçeneğidir.
options: A) Yeni bir rapora göre, yapay zekâ girişimini önceden benimseyenler, bu heyecan verici yeni alanı henüz keşfetmemiş olanlara kıyasla verimlilik ve performans bakımından daha büyük bir gelişme göstermiştir.

B) Yeni hazırlanan bir rapora göre, yapay zekâ girişimini daha keşfetmemiş olanların aksine, bu heyecan verici yeni alanı önceden kullanmaya başlayanlar verimlilik ve performans konularında daha çok ilerleme kaydetmiştir.

C) Yeni bir rapora göre, yeni ve heyecan verici yapay zekâ girişimini önceden benimseyenlerin, bu alanı henüz keşfetmeyenlere göre, verimlilik ve performans açısından çok daha fazla ilerleme kaydettiği görülmüştür.

D) Yeni hazırlanan bir rapor, yapay zeka girişimini önceden edinenlerin, bu heyecan verici yeni alanı keşfetmeyenlerle karşılaştırıldığında verimlilik ve performans bakımından daha fazla gelişme ortaya koyduğunu göstermiştir.

E) Yeni bir rapor, yapay zekâ girişimini önceden benimseyenlerde verimlilik ve performans alanındaki gelişmelerin bu yeni ve heyecan verici alanı keşfetmeyenlere kıyasla daha fazla olduğunu göstermiştir.

questions.questionText: 39. One of the biggest difficulties of a manager is possibly demonstrating leadership in a context where those being directed neither believe they need to be organised, nor are motivated to cooperate with the administration.
questions.explanation: neither ... nor kalıbı 'ne ... ne de' anlamına gelir. 'Bir yöneticinin en büyük zorluklarından biri muhtemelen, yönetilenlerin ne organize edilmeleri gerektiğine inandıkları ne de yönetimle işbirliği yapmaya istekli/motive oldukları bir ortamda liderlik göstermektir.'
options: A) Bir yönetici için muhtemelen en büyük zorluklardan biri, yönetilenlerin ya organize edilmeleri gerektiğine inanmadıkları ya da yönetimle işbirliği yapmaya istekli olmadıkları bir ortamda liderlik göstermektir.

B) Bir yöneticinin en büyük zorluklarından biri muhtemelen, yönetilenlerin ne organize edilmeleri gerektiğine inandıkları ne de yönetimle işbirliği yapmaya istekli oldukları bir ortamda liderlik göstermektir.
C) Bir yöneticinin yaşayabileceği en büyük zorluklardan biri muhtemelen, organize edilmeye ihtiyaç duymayanların ve yönetimle işbirliği yapmayanların olduğu bir ortamda liderlik göstermektir.
D) Bir yönetici olmanın muhtemel en büyük zorluğu, yönetilenlerin organize edilme gereksinimi duymadıkları için yönetimle işbirliği yapmaya istekli olmadığı bir ortamda liderlik göstermektir.
E) Bir yöneticinin yaşayabileceği en büyük zorluk muhtemelen, yönetilenleri ne organize olmaya inandırabildiği ne de yönetimle işbirliği yapmaya motive edebildiği bir ortamda liderlik göstermektir.

questions.questionText: 40. Koalalar yüksek miktarlarda su içeren okaliptus yapraklarıyla beslenirler, bu yüzden nadiren su içmeye ihtiyaç duyarlar ve böylelikle yerdeki yırtıcılardan kurtulmuş olarak ağaçlarda uzun saatler kalabilirler.
questions.explanation: Virgüllerle ve bağlaçlarla sıralanmış yapı (so/therefore) C şıkkında mevcuttur. 'Koalas feed on eucalyptus leaves that contain high amounts of water, so they hardly need to drink water, and therefore they can stay in trees for long hours...'
options: A) Koalas feed on eucalyptus leaves that consist of high amounts of water, and as a result, they rarely need to drink water, which means they can stay in trees for long hours, away from predators on land.
B) Because koalas eat eucalyptus leaves that have excessive amounts of water, they hardly need to drink water and thus they can stay in trees for long hours, away from predators on land.
C) Koalas feed on eucalyptus leaves that contain high amounts of water, so they hardly need to drink water, and therefore they can stay in trees for long hours, safe from predators on land.

D) Eucalyptus leaves that koalas feed on are composed of excessive amounts of water, so they rarely need to drink water and thus they can stay in trees for long hours, which keeps them away from predators on land.

E) Koalas rely on eucalyptus leaves for nourishment, and since they have high amounts of water, koalas scarcely need to drink water, and consequently, they can stay in trees for long hours, free from predators on land.

questions.questionText: 41. Dünya, 66 milyon yıl önce dinozorların neslini tükettiği düşünülen ve sıcaklıkları 5°C'ye kadar artıran bir asteroid etkisinden kaynaklanan sıcak bir dönem geçirmiştir.
questions.explanation: Cümlenin öznesi ve yüklemi 'Dünya... sıcak bir dönem geçirmiştir' (The Earth underwent a hot period). Asteroid etkisinden kaynaklanan kısmı ise 'that stemmed from an asteroid impact...' ile çevrilir.
options: A) The Earth underwent a hot period that stemmed from an asteroid impact thought to have wiped out the dinosaurs 66 million years ago and caused temperatures to rise by 5°C
B) A hot period experienced by the Earth is thought to have caused the extinction of the dinosaurs 66 years ago leading to an asteroid impact with a 5°C increase in temperatures.
C) The extinction of the dinosaurs is thought to have resulted from the 5°C rise in the temperatures during the hot period due to an asteroid impact the Earth experienced 66 million years ago
D) A hot period is thought to ham dominated the Earth, wiping out the dinosaurs 66 million years ago after a 5°C increase in the temperatures together with an asteroid impact
E) The Earth underwent a hot period with the influence of the dinosaurs that became extinct 66 million years ago with an asteroid impact, resulting in the rising of the temperatures

questions.questionText: 42. Avustralya'daki bir çocuk hastanesinde çalışan uzmanlar, bazı insanların 20'li yaşlarına kadar büyümeye devam ettiğine dair pek çok kanıt ortaya koyarak ergenliğin bittiği kabul edilen yaşın 19'dan 24'e çıkarılması gerektiğini öne sürmektedir.
questions.explanation: Cümlenin öznesi 'uzmanlar' (Experts working at a children's hospital in Australia) ve ana fiili 'öne sürmektedir' (suggest that...). 'Kanıt ortaya koyarak' kısmı (revealing plenty of evidence) participle phrase olarak sona eklenmiştir.
options: A) Experts working at a children's hospital in Australia suggest that the recognised age at which adolescence ends should be raised to 24 from 19, revealing plenty of evidence that some people keep growing into their 20s.

B) Experts working at a children's hospital in Australia have provided plenty of evidence that some people keep growing into their 20s, and therefore they claim that the recognised age at which adolescence ends should be raised to 24 from 19.

C) The recognised age at which adolescence ends is 19, but experts working at a children's hospital in Australia claim that it should be raised to 24, providing lots of evidence that some people keep growing into their 20s.

D) Provided that there is abundant evidence suggesting that some people keep growing into their 20s, experts working at a children's hospital in Australia point out that the recognised age at which adolescence ends, which is 19, should be raised to 24.

E) The claim that recognised age at which adolescence ends should be raised to 24 from 19 has been made by the experts working at a children's hospital in Australia, who have revealed plenty of evidence that some people keep growing into their 20s.

questions.questionText: 43. The author clearly states that shyness ----
questions.explanation: Parçanın başında yazar, utangaçlığın yalnız yaşamayı sevenlerden zengin ve ünlülere kadar çok çeşitli insanlar tarafından (from different walks of life) deneyimlenen yaygın bir fenomen olduğunu (widespread phenomenon) belirtmektedir.
options: A) is a widespread phenomenon likely to be experienced by people from different walks of life
B) makes itself clear through several symptoms unvaryingly seen
C) is generally accompanied by some thoughts caused by imaginary conditions
D) is a psychological condition caused by several well-known triggers
E) can be detected by as most of its symptoms are visible

questions.questionText: 44. What can be concluded from the passage about the initial period of life?
questions.explanation: Parçada, yaşamın ilk 3-4 yılında (initial period of life) görülen utangaçlık eğiliminin genç yetişkinliğe kadar korunduğu anlatılmaktadır. Bu da erken dönemin ileri yaşlardaki utangaçlık üzerinde oldukça etkili olduğunu (highly influential) gösterir.
options: A) children who are shy during this period will be shy throughout their lives no matter what they do.
B) If children are shy with others during this period, they should be observed psychologically.
C) It might be highly influential on whether a person will be shy in later life.
D) It is not easy to overcome shyness during this period because personality traits do not change until young adulthood.
E) It is the period when children should leam some self-help techniques to overcome their shyness.

questions.questionText: 45. It could be inferred from the passage that ----.
questions.explanation: Parçadaki 'genetik yatkınlık (genetic predisposition)' ve 'iletişim kurmayan ebeveynlerin (uncommunicative parents) çocuğun gelişimini kısıtlaması' ifadelerinden yola çıkarak, ebeveynlerin genetik aktarım veya yetiştirme tarzlarıyla utangaçlıktan sorumlu olabilecekleri çıkarımı yapılabilir.
options: A) shyness is most likely to be seen among children whose parents were shy in their childhood
B) it can be the parents who are responsible for shyness due to their parenting style or the genetic characteristics they pass on to their children
C) shyness could be considered a form of social phobia, thus medical help should be sought to eliminate it
D) the psychological effects of shyness can be intense if physiological symptoms are accompanied by inner thoughts
E) although we do not know the causes of shyness for sure, it is easy to get rid of this condition

questions.questionText: 46. What is the purpose of the author of this passage?
questions.explanation: Yazar pasaj boyunca utangaçlığın psikolojik/fizyolojik semptomlarını (blushing, sweating, anxious thoughts vb.) ve olası nedenlerini (genetik, aile vb.) kısaca açıklamıştır.
options: A) To elaborate on the impact of genetic factors on shyness
B) To report the findings of recent research into the effects and triggers of shyness
C) To give the reader some advice on how to overcome shyness
D) To give brief information about the symptoms and possible causes of shyness
E) To discuss whether shyness is a challenging psychological problem

questions.questionText: 47. It is understood from the passage that during the 19th century, ----
questions.explanation: Parçada Orta ve Güney Amerika'da köleliğin kaldırılmasının kademeli olarak (gradually in varying degrees) ve farklı zamanlarda gerçekleştiği (Brezilya'nın 1888'de son ülke olması) anlatılmıştır.
options: A) most slaves in Latin American countries were able to become part of the ruling and wealthy classes once they gained independence
B) most of the crops produced by slaves were sold to local consumers in Latin America
C) the abolishment of slavery did not happen at the same time and rate in Central and South America
D) many Latin American countries outlaw slavery after Brazil outlawed it
E) there had been no serious conflicts in Latin America until 1500

questions.questionText: 48. It can be inferred from the passage that in Latin America, ----
questions.explanation: Köleliğin kaldırılmasından (abolishment of slavery) sonra, özgürleşen kölelerin yoksulluk ve eşitsizliğin olduğu alt tabakalara katıldıkları ve bağımsızlığın sadece güç dengesizliği ve ekonomik eşitsizlik (social inequality and political instability) getirdiği belirtilmiştir.
options: A) the abolishment of slavery aroused such problems as social inequality and political instability
B) military dictatorships were a big obstacle to the economic development of most countries
C) rapid growth was mainly due to political achievements and successful management of social conflicts
D) the welfare of citizens greatly improved in most countries after the abolishment of slavery
E) freed slaves were not allowed to purchase land for a long time even after the abolishment of slavery

questions.questionText: 49. According to the passage, which of the following is true about Brazil's rubber boom?
questions.explanation: Pasajın sonunda, bu gelişimin (rubber boom) yerel halkın ihtiyaçları için değil, Avrupa ve Kuzey Amerika gibi endüstrileşmiş ülkelerin ihtiyaçlarına hizmet edecek şekilde tasarlandığı (secondary to those of industrialised countries) ifade ediliyor.
options: A) The needs of Brazilian people were secondary to those of industrialised countries.
B) Local people played a more dominant role in the boom when compared to European and American investors.
C) It was developed for the local people of Brazil to help them escape poverty.
D) It was not as successful as European and American investors had estimated.
E) It was the underlying cause of many wars and civil conflicts in the area.

questions.questionText: 50. What is the primary purpose of the author?
questions.explanation: Yazarın temel amacı, Latin Amerika'daki köleliğin kaldırılmasını takiben yaşanan ekonomik sömürüyü, siyasi istikrarsızlığı ve yoksulluğu yani 'köleliğin kaldırılmasının bazı sonuçlarını' tartışmaktır.
options: A) To explain why slavery was widely practised in Latin America during the 19th century
B) To clarify when slavery was completely ended in Latin America
C) To discuss some consequences of the abolishment of slavery in Latin America
D) To emphasise the considerable efforts of slaves to gain independence in Latin America
E) To justify that investment from Europe and North America helped to end slavery in Latin America

questions.questionText: 51. According to the passage, even if foods do not go bad quickly, ---
questions.explanation: Besinlerin hemen bozulmasalar bile ısı, ışık veya hava gibi etkenlere maruz kalmaktan dolayı vitamin değerlerinin düştüğü (lose nutritional value) belirtilmiştir. Bu da sağlığa daha az katkıda bulunacakları anlamına gelir.
options: A) they may contribute less to our health after a period of exposure to certain factors
B) they could perish if they are exposed to direct sunlight
C) insects and bacteria detect them easily due to their bad smell
D) they may cause changes in a person's gastrointestinal tract
E) people do not wish to eat foods exposed to water for a long time

questions.questionText: 52. Which of the following is true according to the passage?
questions.explanation: Metinde insanların, eti ateşte pişirmeye başladıklarından beri gıdaların bozulmasını engellemeye çalıştıkları (Efforts to avoid food spoilage have been around since...) açıkça belirtilmiştir.
options: A) Yeasts and moulds turn acid into sugar before people consume fruits.
B) Yeasts and moulds may colonise bacteria and insects in warm and low-acid conditions.
C) Efforts to avoid food spoilage have been around since people began cooking meat over a fire.
D) Food preservation started in the 19th century with the advent of pasteurisation.
E) All types of bacteria release toxins, causing acute food poisoning.

questions.questionText: 53. Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?
questions.explanation: 19. yüzyılda gıda koruma biliminin 'önemli ölçüde ilerlediği' (advanced considerably) söylendiğinden, bu yüzyılın gıda koruma biliminin 'çiçek açtığı' (bloomed) dönem olduğu çıkarımı yapılabilir.
options: A) Cooking meat over a fire could cause bacteria to proliferate easier.
B) The 19th century is the period in which the science of food preservation bloomed.
C) Smoking, drying, and salting prevent food spoilage as they eliminate bacteria.
D) Pasteurisation has reduced the practice of other food preservation techniques.
E) Problems in the gastrointestinal tract are usually the result of food poisoning.

questions.questionText: 54. What can be said about foods according to the passage?
questions.explanation: Tüm gıdaların doğal halinde bozulabilir (perishable) olduğu ve bakteriler/mantarlar tarafından yok edilmemesi için korunmaları gerektiği vurgulandığından, spesifik süreçlerle korunmadıkça gıda bozulması kaçınılmazdır.
options: A) Meat, dairy products and low-acid vegetables are the only foods bacteria proliferate.
B) If it is still appetising, consumption of food is harmless even if it is affected by any bacteria.
C) Food spoilage is inevitable unless foods are preserved through specific processes.
D) People tend to keep their spoiled foods even if they look unappetising.
E) Pasteurisation is accepted as the most efficient way to prevent foods from going bad.

questions.questionText: 55. Which of the following is true according to the passage?
questions.explanation: Yazar, yalan makinesinin (lie detector) sadece yalan söylerken fizyolojik tepkiler verdiği fikrinin bir efsane (mythological) olduğunu, testin aslında kontrol sorularıyla kıyaslama (works differently) yaparak işlediğini anlatıyor.
options: A) The number of the control questions is greater than that of the relevant tests.
B) A lie detector device actually works differently from what is usually imagined.
C) One can monitor extraordinary differences of a person's psychology during a lie protector.
D) They record bodily responses before the questions are examined.
E) A majority of innocent people are falsely accused due to their unwillingness to react to the relevant questions.

questions.questionText: 56. It can be inferred from the passage that the relevant questions asked in a standard lie test ----.
questions.explanation: Metne göre kişinin yalan söyleyip söylemediği, 'ilgili' (relevant) sorulara verdiği tepkilerin 'kontrol' (control) sorularına verdiği tepkilerle kıyaslanmasıyla anlaşılır. Yani kontrol soruları olmadan ilgili sorular işe yaramaz.
options: A) are expected to induce standard bodily responses from the respondent
B) are used to disguise the control questions, which yield typical reactions
C) would not be of much use without the control questions
D) makes people overreact to the questions, which hard to differentiate them from the liars.
E) The answers given to the control questions bear no relation to the answers to the relevant ones.

questions.questionText: 57. What is the disadvantage of the test used in specific issue investigations?
questions.explanation: Doğru söyleyen masum insanların da 'ilgili sorular' karşısında rahatsız olabileceği ve aşırı tepki verebileceği (react more strongly to them), bu yüzden testin yalan söylemeyen aleyhine önyargılı (biased against truthful) olabileceği anlatılmıştır.
options: A) Some truthful test-takers are unwilling to answer the relevant questions because they do not seem issue investigations.
B) Honest test-takers might overreact to the questions, which makes it hard to differentiate them from the liars.
C) It is lying if he or she reacts similar bodily changes in innocent.
D) Researchers usually find the test unreliable, which makes the test impractical for investigative purposes.
E) The respondent's bodily reactions particularly by a series of questions.

questions.questionText: 58. Which could be the best title for this passage?
questions.explanation: Metin genel olarak yalan makinelerinin nasıl çalıştığını (temel çalışma prensipleri) ve yanıtlayan kişinin tepkilerinin nasıl ölçüldüğünü anlattığından en uygun başlık 'Yalan Makinelerinin Temel Çalışma Prensibi'dir.
options: A) How to Deceive Lie Detectors
B) Question Types for Lie Protector Tests
C) The Basic Working Principle of Lie Detectors
D) The History and Development of Lie Detectors
E) Investigating Financial Crime through Lie Detectors

questions.questionText: 59. Which of the following is true about the books people read in childhood according to the passage?
questions.explanation: Metindeki 'books read in childhood can stay with us forever' ifadesi, çocuklukta okunan kitapları hayatımız boyunca hatırladığımızı (remember them throughout the course of our lives) göstermektedir.
options: A) People form their reading habits thanks to the pictures these books contain.
B) Children's books are usually better than picture in helping become a published writer.
C) Such books are written for the purpose of learning sounds and letters.
D) We often remember them throughout the course of our lives.
E) It may not be possible to be a good writer without analysing them carefully.

questions.questionText: 60. Why is it important to read outside your favourite genre?
questions.explanation: Metin, daha geniş okudukça ('The more widely you read') başkalarının bunu nasıl yaptığını ('See how others do it') göreceğinizi, yani farklı stil ve yapılardan haberdar olacağınızı (To learn about different styles and structures) söyler.
options: A) To imitate the great writers who have written before you
B) To learn about different styles and structures available
C) To see which of the genres are making the biggest profits
D) To decide what genre is the best for your target group of readers
E) To get inspired by the popular themes of the great writers

questions.questionText: 61. Which of the following could replace the underlined verb 'count' in the passage?
questions.explanation: Yazıda geçen 'make every word count' kalıbındaki 'count', her kelimenin 'önemli olmasını' sağlamak demektir. Buna anlamca en yakın kelime 'matter' (önemli olmak) fiilidir.
options: A) stimulate
B) imply
C) matter
D) occur
E) necessitate

questions.questionText: 62. What is the main purpose of the author?
questions.explanation: Paragraf yazar olmak isteyen kişilere (aspiring writer) ne okumaları gerektiği, diğer türleri nasıl incelemeleri gerektiği gibi çeşitli rehberlik ve tavsiyeler sunmaktadır (guidelines to people wanting to become writers).
options: A) To give information on how to read more effectively
B) To explain briefly what the great authors do and do not do
C) To describe the similarities and differences between reading and writing
D) To offer some guidelines to people wanting to become writers
E) To compare and contrast a variety of literary genres for the enthusiasts

questions.questionText: 63. Mary: So, I've decided to participate in the Citizen Science movement. Hilda: And what exactly are you expected to do as part of this movement? Mary: Nothing special, in fact. Science volunteers can contribute to global science studies by simply monitoring whales offshore or hawks and stars in the sky. Hilda: ---- Mary: Not really! It's simple to do with basic technology, like smartphone apps.
questions.explanation: Hilda 'Bedavaya yardım eden amatör bir araştırmacı olmanızı mı istiyorlar?' diye sorunca Mary 'Tam olarak değil, akıllı telefon gibi basit teknolojilerle yapılıyor' diyerek sistemin pratikliğini açıklıyor.
options: A) That's interesting. So they invite you to be an amateur researcher who offers help for free?
B) Sounds impressive. Would you need to use special equipment in order to record these things?
C) That's exciting. But don't you think you should be able to earn money for this kind of work?
D) Hmm. I see. Doesn't this benefit the research team more than it benefits the volunteers?
E) Wow. Is accuracy one of the top priorities in these types of observations?

questions.questionText: 64. Molly: So, I really liked the film. Actually, it really went way beyond my expectations. James: Yeah, the special effects were pretty cool but I didn't like how long the film was. I mean, seriously, why would any film need to be nearly three hours long? Molly: Well, with this kind of film it takes a lot of time to develop the plot and the characters. Don't you think so? James: I get what you're saying, but ---- Molly: I still think most of them were needed in the film so that it could convey its message to the audience in a meaningful way.
questions.explanation: Molly karakter gelişimi için zaman gerektiğini söylüyor. James 'Ne demek istediğini anlıyorum ama...' dedikten sonra filmin çok uzadığını ve bazı sahnelerin gereksiz olduğunu söylemelidir (D şıkkı).
options: A) Not really. But since this was a sequel it must have taken longer to develop some of the themes of the story for people who haven't seen the first one.
B) I agree that it must be a challenge for the writers to such a complex plot and develop it into a shorter film, but still got really bored.
C) Nope but I think the problem is actually with the cinema itself rather than the film. In some countries, a break is given partway through the film.
D) Well, you have a point there. It does take time. Maybe the problem was with the story itself. I believe many critics would just agree with me.
E) Actually, I don't. Some of the scenes were unnecessary because they didn't stick to the central theme of the story.

questions.questionText: 65. Maggie: Last week you said you didn't feel so well and you'd join a gym. Lucy: That's true, but I have so much work to do that I can hardly find the time to even call up for information on how to best get fit. Maggie: ---- Lucy: It's definitely better than nothing. Maybe I can try to discipline myself and start doing some stretching at my office.
questions.explanation: Lucy ofisinde esneme hareketleri yapmaktan bahsediyor ('stretching at my office'). Bunun öncesinde Maggie ona spor salonuna gerek olmadığını, 5 dakikalık egzersizin bile faydalı olduğunu önermelidir.
options: A) You keep finding excuses, and I think the problem is your tendency to delay. If you really want to create some time, I'm sure you can find a way.
B) Actually, you don't really need a gym. Most professionals say even five minutes of light exercise can be beneficial for your health.
C) You'd better get some advice from a doctor rather than hit the gym. Using prescribed medicines can help you lose weight in a controlled way.
D) You shouldn't worry se much about trivial things. Going to the gym can make you feel happy, as the key to a happy life is to be able to find pleasure in small things.
E) I think you should reorganise your weekly schedule. There are various techniques for planning your day so that you can have some time for yourself.

questions.questionText: 66. Alan: We are all told to exercise more, but for those with physical disabilities, the benefits of aerobic exercise have always been out of reach. I think scientists need to find a solution for this. Chelsea: In fact, I have read about a recent study which aims to develop a kind of drug that will create the effect of exercise for those with physical disabilities. Alan: ---- Chelsea: Thanks to the medication, the genes which prove resistant to weight gain can be activated without any physical training.
questions.explanation: Chelsea bir ilaçtan (drug) bahsedince Alan ilacın bu fiziksel aktivite eksikliğini nasıl telafi edebileceğini (How can that drug compensate...) sorar. Chelsea de ilacın mekanizmasını (genleri aktive etmesini) açıklar.
options: A) How can that drug compensate for the lack of physical activity?
B) How interested would you be in taking the drug yourself?
C) How often is the drug taken to activate fat burning mechanisms.
D) How do disabled people feel after taking this kind of drug?
E) How much do they agree on the impact of the drug on people?

questions.questionText: 67. Patient: I have a sore throat and this is the third in the last six months. My tonsils will probably need to be removed. Doctor: It used to be a common practice a few decades ago, but today we approach tonsil removal with much more caution. Patient: ---- Doctor: We take little notice of our palatine tonsils, except when they are sore, but they activate our immune system, recognising pathogens entering through the mouth and nose. Patient: So I should take better care of them instead of having them removed.
questions.explanation: Doktor bademciklerin bağışıklık sistemine faydalarından (activate our immune system) bahsedince, hasta bunun mantıklı olup olmadığını sorarak ameliyatın son seçenek olması gerektiğini iddia eder (Does it really make sense? Surgery is supposed to be the last option...).
options: A) I can't see why patients are driven to such risks. There must be a good side that may be less obvious to us.
B) But when inflamed, they are extremely painful. Why should I tolerate them if I can easily get rid of them?
C) So vaccination can provide protection against specific diseases? Is it possible to prevent infection this way?
D) Oh! I would have had medical treatment instead of having them removed through surgery if I had known that.
E) Does it really make sense? Surgery is supposed to be the last option in such cases regarding the immune system.

questions.questionText: 68. Recent studies have suggested that underground water does not freeze despite temperatures being as low as -70°C, as it is prevented by salt present in water.
questions.explanation: Orijinal cümledeki 'tuzun donmayı önlemesi sayesinde -70 derecede bile yer altı suyunun donmaması (sıvı kalması)' anlamı, A seçeneğindeki 'because the salt in the water prevents freezing, water underground stays liquid even when the temperature is as low as -70°C' yapısıyla en iyi şekilde ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) It has been suggested by recent studies that because the salt in the water prevents freezing, water underground stays liquid even when the temperature is as low as -70°C
B) As recent studies have suggested, underground water freezes when the temperature reaches -70°C, despite the fact that salt in water generally prevents freezing.
C) Recent studies have suggested that water remains liquid under the ground until the temperature reaches -70°C and enough salt is present.
D) According to some recent studies, as underground water remains as low as -70°C the salt stops the temperatures.
E) Recent studies maintained that as soon as the temperature reaches -70°C, the salt in underground water prevents its freezing.

questions.questionText: 69. Thinking about 'what-ifs' is commonly thought to be a futile exercise; however, it helps individuals make sense of their past experiences and prepare for the future.
questions.explanation: 'Ne olsaydı'lar hakkında düşünmenin genellikle boş bir eylem (futile exercise) olduğu düşünülse de aslında geçmişi anlamlandırmaya ve geleceğe hazırlanmaya yardımcı olduğu zıtlığı, E seçeneğindeki 'Contrary to popular belief, ... is not a useless exercise...' ile mükemmel uyum sağlar.
options: A) Thinking about 'what-ifs' is thought to be helpful in taking lessons from past experiences and being more cautious about the future, even though it is actually an exercise that has no meaning.
B) Although it is widely believed to be an unnecessary exercise, making sense of past experiences lets individuals think about 'what-ifs', teaching them life lessons in the long run.
C) People should think about their 'what-ifs' because it is not a pointless exercise; it is something that is useful and effective for both the past and future.
D) Thinking about 'what-ifs' is not only a popular activity exercised by many, but also a sensible tool to make meanings of the past and get ready for future experiences in advance.
E) Contrary to popular belief, thinking about 'what-ifs' is not a useless exercise; it is rather something that lets people make meaningful inferences about the past and be ready for the future.

questions.questionText: 70. The only time that an analysis procedure can help is when the user is fully aware not only of its strong points, but its shortcomings as well.
questions.explanation: Kullanıcının bir analiz prosedürünün sadece güçlü noktalarının değil eksikliklerinin de farkında olması gerektiği, A şıkkında 'fully aware of both the strengths and weaknesses of an analysis procedure to be able to benefit from it' ifadesiyle eksiksiz olarak tekrar yazılmıştır.
options: A) The user is to be fully aware of both the strengths and weaknesses of an analysis procedure to be able to benefit from it.
B) An analysis procedure should have more strong points than shortcomings in order for the user to be aware of its benefits.
C) Both the strengths and weaknesses of an analysis procedure should be fully evaluated before the user becomes aware of its benefits
D) An analysis procedure can help the user only if the user acknowledges the strong points rather than its shortcomings.
E) The shortcomings of an analysis procedure can reduce its benefits only when the user is not fully aware of its strong points.

questions.questionText: 71. Although the household technological products are interesting to users from all age groups, they are particularly significant to older people with sensory or motor limitations, due to the high degree of operational comfort and safety they offer.
questions.explanation: Her yaş grubunun ilgisini çekse de (attract the attention of consumers of all ages), özellikle duyusal ve motor kısıtlamaları olan yaşlılar için yüksek derece konfor ve güvenlik sağlaması bakımından önemlidir anlamı B şıkkında tam karşılığını bulur.
options: A) Household technological products offer a high level of operational comfort and safety to people of all ages; nevertheless, it is the elderly who find them the most useful, especially if they have sensory and motor limitations

B) Household technological products attract the attention of consumers of all ages, but they are especially important to the elderly who have sensory and motor limitations as these devices provide a great degree of operational comfort and safety.

C) Despite the fact that people from various age groups are interested in household technology, the biggest group who needs them is the elderly since they seek a high degree of operational comfort and safety because of their sensory and motor limitations.

D) Household technológical devices are significant for people of all ages, but they are especially important to those with sensory and motor limitations, such as old people, because these devices are comfortable and safe to operate.

E) Though many people find household technological devices important owing to their high level of operational comfort and safety, these devices are particularly aimed at people with sensory and motor limitations, regardless of their age.

questions.questionText: 72. With few exceptions, the Austronesian languages are closely interrelated. In spite of their very large number and the enormous expanse of the territories occupied by them, it is very easy to recognise their genetic interrelationship. ---- As a result of this, the total number of Austronesian languages is a contentious issue. Taking this into account, the approximate number of Austronesian languages of given areas, and the number of their speakers in these areas could be detected only if a wide-scale scientific study is conducted.
questions.explanation: Dillerin çok benzer olduğundan bahsediliyor. Sonra 'Bunun bir sonucu olarak toplam sayıları tartışmalıdır' (contentious issue) deniliyor. Bu geçişi sağlamak için A seçeneğindeki 'birbirlerine olan büyük benzerlikleri nedeniyle hangisinin farklı bir dil, hangisinin bir lehçe olduğunu belirlemek zordur' cümlesi konulmalıdır.
options: A) Because of their great similarity to each other, it is often difficult to establish whether certain varieties are different languages, or dialects of one language.
B) Phonologically, Austronesian languages are, with a few exceptions, fairly simple.
C) Like other language groups, the Austronesian languages are thought to have originated thousands of years ago.
D) The recognition of the genetic interrelationship and initial classification of Austronesian languages had its beginnings in the nineteenth century.
E) There are four types of indigenous languages in the Australasia and the Pacific area:

questions.questionText: 73. At the very least, the egocentric bias causes us to misunderstand others. It undermines empathy and tolerance. It also traps us in a bubble and we waste vast amount of psychic energy recovering from insults that were never targeted at us in the first place. To live a life that is less reactive, more directed, it is necessary to put the ego in its place. ---- We can then see situations with clarity and approach them effectively. We may even see the wisdom in others' point of view, and learn from them.
questions.explanation: Egomuzu yenmek için kendi bakış açımızın tek veya en iyisi olmadığını kabul etmeliyiz (A seçeneği), 'ancak o zaman' (We can then...) durumları net bir şekilde görebilir ve başkalarının bakış açılarındaki bilgeliği görebiliriz.
options: A) We can cognitively prompt ourselves to recognise that our own point of view is not the only one, or necessarily the best one.
B) Social psychologists say our tilt to egocentricity is deeply ingrained as it helps us maintain a coherent narrative of the events in our lives.
C) Even so, it is essential for all of us to recognise the egocentric bias for what it is: an adaptive illusion.
D) There are some situations in which such ego-shifts occur naturally, with little effort - sublime experiences that defy comprehension.
E) Some studies also find that memento mori, reminders of the impermanence of life, also displace the self from centre

questions.questionText: 74. The mind is a problem-solving organ that allows us to deal with events in imagination before they are faced in reality. That amazing skill has, over the last 10,000 years, allowed us, a weak, slow, and poorly defended species, to take over the planet. ---- We are living longer, even in the poorest countries. Violence is down, despite how things appear on our screens. We have made human progress.
questions.explanation: Zihnin olayları önceden tasarlama yeteneği sayesinde dünyayı ele geçirdiğimiz anlatılmış, ardından boşluk bırakılmış ve ömrümüzün uzadığı, şiddetin azaldığı (insanlık gelişimi örnekleri) verilmiştir. A şıkkında 'Yüzyıllar önce karşılaşılan bazı zorlukların halledilmiş veya azaltılmış olduğu' belirtilerek bu gelişime köprü kurulmuştur.
options: A) Some of the real-world difficulties a person faced centuries ago have been taken care of or at least diminished.
B) Still, choosing values takes a certain amount of psychological sophistication to rein in the problem-solving mind.
C) When we engage the capacity to choose and to embrace the values that inform our actions, we are humanising ourselves.
D) Our mental capacity can serve as an ever-present compass, letting us know we are straying from our true purpose.
E) Sometimes we get so caught up in our own thinking that we risk turning our values into a pros-and-cons list.

questions.questionText: 75. A tendency to sleep at a set time each day defines an individual's 'chronotype'. Although strongly influenced by genetics and light exposure, age-related body changes play a key role. Puberty heralds a notable shift as bedtimes and wake-up times get later. ---- By 55 we wake at around the time we did as young children, approximately two hours earlier than as adolescents. Thus, a 7 am alarm for a teenager feels like a 5 am start for a person in their 50s.
questions.explanation: Metinde ergenlikte uyuma ve uyanma saatlerinin daha geçe kaydığı (get later) anlatılmıştır. B şıkkında bu trendin erkeklerde ve kadınlarda 20'li yaşlara kadar devam edip sonra yavaş yavaş tersine döndüğü (gradually reverses) ifade edilir; ki bu durum 55 yaşındakilerin neden ergenlerden erken uyandığını bağlar.
options: A) Teenagers need about 9 hours for best academic performance, however, many of them get far less.
B) This trend continues until 19.5 years in women and nearly 21 in men, then gradually reverses.
C) A Canadian study compared cognitive performance mid-morning and mid-afternoon in teenagers and adults.
D) Not surprisingly, teachers in their 50s will generally be at their best in the morning, unlike their teenage students.
E) More relaxed attitude towards bedtimes, ignorance about sleep and addictive use of social media make this shift worse.

questions.questionText: 76. (I) Wagner was a musical innovator who revolutionised opera by creating vast music-dramas for which he wrote both the music and the words - previously composers had used stories written by librettists. (II) He wanted to create a combination of all the arts music, poetry, drama, and painting which he called a Gesamtkunstwerk. (III) In addition, each major character, symbol, or place in his dramas had its individual musical theme, or leitmotif, that accompanied it throughout the opera. (IV) The greatest use of this technique came in his Ring Cycle, an epic story told over four operas. (V) In his essay On Conducting, he proposed that a creative conductor should actively interpret music, rather than just control an orchestra like a traffic cop.
questions.explanation: İlk 4 cümlede Wagner'in Gesamtkunstwerk (tüm sanatların birleşimi) ve 'leitmotif' (müzikal tema) kavramları üzerinden operada yaptığı devrim anlatılırken, (V) numaralı cümlede aniden 'orkestra şefliği' hakkındaki makalesi ve şeflerin nasıl olması gerektiğine dair görüşlerine geçilmiştir. Anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle (V)'tir.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 77. (I) In the late 15th century, when Europeans first travelled into the Western Hemisphere, Mesoamerica was dominated by the vast empire of the Aztecs. (II) Today, many people in both Mesoamerica and along the Caribbean are of mixed background. (III) But within decades of the European arrival, Spanish conquerors had overwhelmed those powerful people and all other major groups. (IV) Native Aztec, Zapotec, Mixtec, and others were congregated into European-style villages and towns and forcibly converted to Roman Catholicism. (V) However, Europeans also introduced them to new sources of income, making them no longer dependent on traditionally practiced agriculture.
questions.explanation: Pasaj 15. yüzyılda Avrupalıların Amerika'ya gelişi, Aztek imparatorluğu, İspanyol fatihlerin onları yenmesi ve yerlilerin zorla Katolik yapılması gibi tarihsel gelişmeleri aktarmaktadır. (II) numaralı cümle ise aniden 'Bugün Mesoamerika'da pek çok insan karışık kökenlidir' diyerek kronolojik ve tematik akışı kırmaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 78. (I) Some of the most common reasons for early childhood hearing loss are genetic. (II) Inner ear hair cells are responsible for detecting sound signals and sending them to the brain, but gene mutations within those cells lead to poorly functioning anatomy. (III) Researchers working with mice have devised a method for replacing those flawed genes with healthy versions: they put the healthy genes into a modified virus and inject it into the inner ear. (IV) The main test of restored ear function involves exposing the rodents to a sudden, startling noise to see if they jump. (V) When the virus infects the ear hair cells, it delivers the healthy genes.
questions.explanation: Paragraf genetik işitme kaybının farelerde virüs aracılığıyla onarılması için geliştirilen gen terapisinin (sağlıklı gen aktarımının) aşamalarını anlatmaktadır (I, II, III ve V). Ancak (IV) numaralı cümle, tedavi mekanizmasını bölen ve işitmenin farelerde ani seslerle test edildiğini anlatan kopuk bir detaydır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 79. (I) It is well documented in the literature that anxiety disorders often co-occur with other diagnoses, including depression and other anxiety disorders. (II) However, it is important to examine whether this is true for the elderly as well. (III) Unlike anxiety or depression, the incidence of cognitive impairment increases with age. (IV) Research is beginning to shed light on the co-occurrence of depression and other psychiatric disorders in older adults. (V) There is evidence suggesting that as with younger adults, depression most frequently co-occurs with anxiety disorders among elderly patients.
questions.explanation: Paragraf, anksiyete, depresyon ve diğer psikiyatrik hastalıkların özellikle yaşlı hastalarda 'birlikte görülme' (co-occurrence) durumu üzerine ilerlemektedir. (III) numaralı cümle ise bilişsel bozulmadan (cognitive impairment) bahsederek metnin depresyon/anksiyete birlikteliği konusundan sapmaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 80. (I) In 2002, the Department of Experimental Psychology at Oxford University took a group of 50 insomniacs and got them to try different ways to fall asleep. (II) Those using the traditional sheep-counting method took slightly longer than the average. (III) Some sleep research seems to suggest that punctuating long working hours with brief 'power naps' of just a few minutes may be good for health. (IV) What worked best was imagining a tranquil scene such as a beach or a waterfall: this relaxes people and engages their imagination. (V) On the other hand, counting sheep is too boring or irritating to take your mind off whatever is keeping you awake.
questions.explanation: Metin, Oxford Üniversitesi'nin uykuya dalmakta zorluk çeken uykusuzluk hastaları (insomniacs) üzerinde denediği koyun saymak veya manzaralar hayal etmek gibi uykuya dalma yöntemlerinden bahsediyor. (III) numaralı cümlede uzun çalışma saatleri arasında sağlığa iyi geldiği söylenen kısa uykulardan (power naps) bahsedilmesi metnin odağını tamamen bozmaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V
